category_edits.rationale: Halve the default initial learning rate for all four category models to reduce update size and potentially preserve ranking quality. Retain cosine decay to 10% of the initial rate, Adam, early stopping, the 200-epoch cap, and all other settings.

response.change_summary: Reduce the default learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005; cosine minimum correspondingly becomes 0.00005. Architecture, loss, routing, and predictor remain unchanged.
